title: Generalized rescaling limits of a sequence of rational maps
summary: We consider a sequence of complex rational maps (f_n) of a fixed degree d at least 2. Building on the seminal work of Kiwi, we introduce the notion of generalized rescaling limits. These are rational maps possibly defined over a non-Archimedean field obtained by renormalizing at some scale a fixed iterate of the sequence (f_n). We explain that the set of all generalized rescaling limits is naturally organized as a tree, and bound the size of this tree in term of the degree d. We apply our theory to quadratic rational maps.
